黑色的奔驰S600平稳地滑入香蜜湖名车汇的专属VIP车位。

老李迅速下车，绕到后排，左手垫着车顶，右手拉开车门。

一股夹杂着机油香和高级香薰味的冷气从巨大的玻璃幕墙里透出来。

林川迈步下车。

沈曼紧随其后。

她的心跳微微有些快。

名车汇。

2000年深圳最大的进口豪车集散地。

大厅里光可鉴人的大理石地面上，倒映着一辆辆在灯光下泛着冰冷金属光泽的钢铁巨兽。

一个穿着黑色职业套装的女销售快步迎了上来。目光在林川和沈曼身上快速扫过。

男人太年轻。穿着没有任何明显lOgO的黑T恤和休闲裤。

女人太漂亮。明艳得像个大明星，身上背着香奈儿。

女销售的脑子里瞬间闪过好几种人物画像。富二代带小明星？还是哪个大老板的白手套？

但当她余光瞥见门外那辆挂着连号车牌的香格里拉专属S600时，脸上的职业微笑瞬间真诚了八度。

“先生您好，请问有心仪的车型吗？”女销售微微欠身，声音甜美。

林川目光在大厅里扫了一圈。

几十万的奔驰宝马，上百万的保时捷法拉利，错落有致。

“随便看看。”林川看了看展台，“带我看看现车吧。”

“好的，那您这边请。”

两人跟着销售往展厅深处走。

沈曼走在林川身侧，保持着半个肩膀的距离。

她平时眼界不低，但真正走进这种动辄几百万的豪车展厅，心里还是隐隐有些发虚。

但旁边的林川，脚步不急不缓。

眼神扫过那些贴着七位数标签的豪车时，跟逛菜市场没什么区别。

“哟，这年头，什么阿猫阿狗都敢往VIP展区钻了？”

一个极度不和谐的破锣嗓子突然从斜刺里传过来。

林川停下脚步。

转过头。

几米外，一辆黑色的宝马5系旁边，站着个四十多岁的中年男人。

大腹便便，脑袋半秃。脖子上挂着一根小拇指粗的金链子，手腕上的劳力士金表在射灯下晃得人眼晕。

男人怀里搂着个穿吊带裙的年轻女人，妆化得很浓，正不自然地盯着沈曼多看了好几眼。

没办法。

沈曼今天就算只穿了件简单的真丝裙，那种明艳大气的五官和浑然天成的曲线，也足够把那个吊带女秒得连渣都不剩。

秃顶男人的一双浑浊小眼睛，从刚才就死死黏在沈曼的领口和腰线上，根本挪不开。

贪婪。

嫉妒。

他摸爬滚打大半辈子才睡得上身边这种货色，凭什么一个毛都没长齐的小白脸，能带着这种极品在豪车展厅里晃悠？

“看什么看？”秃顶男人对上林川平静的眼神，莫名觉得一阵火大，声音拔高了两度，“老子说错了吗？不知道从哪借了辆车就跑来充门面，带个漂亮妞蹭空调拍照片，装什么大尾巴狼！”

沈曼的脸色瞬间冷了下来。

她平时在飞机上遇到这种没素质的暴发户多了，但今天，她下意识地看了一眼林川。

她怕林川年轻气盛，直接跟对方打起来。

“我装不装不知道，但你这副不懂装懂的样子倒是挺明显。”

林川淡淡说了一句，随后随意地收回视线，连多看一眼的兴趣都没有。

他看向旁边的女销售。

The black Mercedes-Benz S600 slid smoothly into the exclusive VIP parking space of Xiangmi Lake Famous Car Collection.

Lao Li quickly got out of the car, walked around to the back seat, put his left hand on the roof of the car, and opened the door with his right hand.

A stream of cold air mixed with the scent of machine oil and high-end aromatherapy came out from the huge glass curtain wall.

Lin Chuan stepped out of the car.

Shen Man followed closely behind.

Her heartbeat was slightly fast.

Luxury Car Collection.

In 2000, it was the largest distribution center for imported luxury cars in Shenzhen.

The shiny marble floor in the hall reflects the steel behemoths that glow with a cold metallic luster under the light.

A saleswoman wearing a black business suit quickly came up to him.His eyes quickly glanced at Lin Chuan and Shen Man.

The man is too young.Wearing a black T-shirt and casual pants without any obvious logo.

The woman is so beautiful.She is as bright as a big star, wearing Chanel on her back.

Several portraits of characters flashed through the saleswoman's mind.The rich second generation takes care of little stars?Or some big boss’s white gloves?

But when she caught a glimpse of the Shangri-La exclusive S600 with a serial number plate outside the door, the professional smile on her face instantly became more sincere.

"Hello sir, do you have your favorite car model?" The female saleswoman leaned slightly and her voice was sweet.

Lin Chuan glanced around the hall.

There are hundreds of thousands of Mercedes-Benz and BMWs, and millions of Porsches and Ferraris, all in good order.

"Just take a look." Lin Chuan looked at the booth, "Take me to see the existing cars."

"Okay, please come this way."

The two of them followed the salesman deeper into the exhibition hall.

Shen Man walked beside Lin Chuan, keeping half a shoulder distance.

She usually has a good vision, but when she actually walked into a showroom of luxury cars that cost millions, she still felt a little guilty.

But Lin Chuan next to him walked slowly and slowly.

When my eyes glanced at the luxury cars with seven-digit labels, it was no different from visiting a vegetable market.

"Hey, these days, all the cats and dogs dare to go to the VIP exhibition area?"

An extremely discordant, broken gong voice suddenly came from the diagonal stab.

Lin Chuan stopped.

Turn your head.

A few meters away, next to a black BMW 5 Series, stood a middle-aged man in his forties.

He has a big belly and a half-bald head.A gold chain as thick as a little finger hung around his neck, and the gold Rolex watch on his wrist dazzled under the spotlight.

The man held a young woman in a suspender skirt in his arms. She was wearing heavy makeup and was staring at Shen Mando several times unnaturally.

no way.

Even if Shen Man only wore a simple silk skirt today, her bright and majestic facial features and natural curves were enough to make that girl in suspenders look like nothing.

The bald man's small, cloudy eyes had been glued to Shen Man's collar and waistline since just now, unable to move away at all.

greedy.

envy.

It took him most of his life to sleep with something like this around him. How could a pretty boy with no hair on his face be able to wander around a luxury car showroom with such a top-notch product?

"What are you looking at?" The bald man met Lin Chuan's calm eyes and felt inexplicably angry. He raised his voice twice, "Did I make a mistake? I borrowed a car from nowhere and came here to show off my appearance. I brought a pretty girl to the air conditioner to take photos. Why are you pretending to be a wolf with a big tail!"

Shen Man's face instantly turned cold.

She usually met many such unqualified upstarts on the plane, but today, she glanced at Lin Chuan subconsciously.

She was afraid that Lin Chuan would fight him directly because he was young and energetic.

"I don't know whether I'm pretending or not, but it's quite obvious that you're pretending to understand."

Lin Chuan said lightly, and then casually withdrew his gaze, not even interested in taking another look.

He looked at the saleswoman next to him.
